name: Peter Petrillo
bioAdditions: Peter is 12 in April 1910 and 22 in January 1920, which supports birth in 1897–98 (S1, S2). That is consistent with the FS date of 26 Jul 1897 only if Grace/Katie was born in January 1897 and Peter was a twin or the dates are slightly off; the 1910 ages (13 and 12) suggest they were about a year apart, so one of the two dates is probably wrong. The FamilySearch tree links him through a Social Security NUMIDENT entry to a son, Victor M. Petrillo (1926–1989), whose mother is given as 'Anna Harosko' (S3).

relationships.evidence: FS NUMIDENT index for Victor M Petrillo names parents Peter Petrillo and Anna Harosko
